name: JBL TestLab Comparator Set
description: Comprehensive reagent comparator covering the planted-tank parameter set. Published ranges include pH 3.0–10.0, KH 0–20 dKH, GH 0.6–16.8 dGH (titration), ammonium, nitrite, nitrate, phosphate, CO2 (calculated from pH + KH), Fe and more. The subset modelled here is the husbandry-relevant core.
notes: The full comparator covers more parameters than the subset listed; ranges shown are the published comparator scales for the husbandry-core parameters. GH/KH are drop-count titrations rather than colour swatches.
